buy_zone.comment: BEEKEEPER SETTING. Default NUK3R2 buy zone = NEZ (82.6-78.6) + NDCAZ (100-82.6), i.e. price has retraced at least 78.6% of the ATL->structural-high move but has NOT broken the 100% bottom. anchor_rule both_structures = price must be inside the buy zone on BOTH the Wick-High and the Body-High structure (the stricter of the two). Change only with beekeeper approval.

structure_rules.bottom: lowest low (ATL) in the study window
structure_rules.top: highest high (wick) and highest max(open,close) (body) AFTER the ATL candle
structure_rules.comment: Explicit, deterministic anchor rules so the zone watcher can run unattended. Anything that fails them is NEEDS_REVIEW or DATA_ERROR and can never trigger a buy. A new ATL breaks the structure (BROKEN) and re-anchors on the next scan; a new high after the ATL re-anchors the top. Every re-anchor gets a new structure_id.
